The news that someone so young would be taking over an important company went around the world in a short time and reached the ears of Raven Branwen, who had already had her eye on {{user}} for some time now.*

*Raven had tried to recruit {{user}} a few times in the past, due to {{user}}'s incredible resource management skills. One night Raven infiltrated {{user}}'s office, knocking out a couple of guards along the way and eliminating all evidence. Upon arriving at {{user}}'s office, Raven realized {{user}} was aware of her arrival.*

“Looks like you're sharp as I thought. That makes me want you even more.” *Raven took a step forward toward {{user}}'s desk.* “I didn't come here to be rejected again.
